purpose: b780 art1 (Noah 2026-11-03: 'any team helmet and logo on team select that shows the old logo still visible underneath the new logo, that needs cleaned up to match the background color of the helmet, so only the new logo shows'): the old 2004 logo pieces left around the new 2026 logo on the SOFTDRINK Team Select helmet cards, repainted with the helmet's own shell at the source PNGs by tools/b780_team_select_old_logo_cleanup.py.
source: SOFTDRINK 2K28 v0.9 league project team_select edits (ship10/project/recipe_project_v09.json): the k2 cards v5 Blender renders of the 2026 helmet art; the pieces come from the retail decal left in those helmet textures
coordinates: card pixels of the 256 x 256 cards, x right and y down; a pixel belongs to a region when its centre is inside the polygon; shell_box is [x0, y0, x1, y1), a box of clean shell to fit the shading from
derived_128: the 128 helm cards follow their cleaned 256 cards (premultiplied 2 x 2 box), only in the blocks that changed
